anomalies.observed: On the MCU sheet the USB-C receptacle VBUS pin (J12, pin A4) carries the net label 'VBUS' on the same wire that is tied to a '+5V' power symbol. On the Power sheet 'VBUS' is the mux OUTPUT net (U5 pin 1) and '+5V' is the mux IN2 net (U5 pin 2). Because both names appear on the USB VBUS wire, the +5V input net and the VBUS mux-output net are merged into one net, so U5.OUT is shorted to U5.IN2 and to the USB 5V pin.
